subject: Textures DELTA3 final: n2r v3 draw options + tests; line-DRAW gap
body: Final delta3. Production n2r now has n2r_validate_v3/n2r_build_v3 and struct n2r_draw_options {version=1, flags, int32 vertex_base, uint32 base_instance}; flags FLAT_SHADING=1 (v9 TILER_CONTEXT.first_provoking_vertex word2 bit18), WRITE_VERTEX_BASE=2 (signed FAU byte64, requires vertex_fau_words>=17), WRITE_BASE_INSTANCE=4 (uint32 FAU byte68, requires>=18, adds BI*stride to input_rate ATTRIBUTE rows). MALI_PRIMITIVE.base_vertex_offset stays0. q->vertex remains render's per-vertex rebased base; n2r does not add vertex_base twice. Default v1/v2 NULL options are byte-identical. Host test test_draw_options vs v9 oracle: tiler bit, FAU -3/5, primitive base0, attr0 offset0, attr1 offset16+5*4; invalid version/flags/fau refusals preserve output. n2r suite 10 PASS release+ASan; helper 806; full frontend ARM64 syntax PASS. Render contract ACK posted; compute must add n2mb_draw_v3 and Dispatch fields. Known source discrepancy: pinned v9.xml has no DRAW.flat_shading_vertex (only v4-v7), Mesa pan_jm sets it only PAN_ARCH<=7; arch9 uses TILER. n2r does not fabricate overloaded word0 bit8; triangle flat implemented, line-list flat explicit unresolved hardware-contract gap. No phone/build/commit/publish.
